# h3_security_group (Data Source)

Looks up a security group by `id`, or by `project_id` + `name` (case-insensitive; `name = "default"` finds the project
default group).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_security_group" "default" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Security group ID.
- `name` (String) Group name (case-insensitive).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID for a lookup by `name`; the provider default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `attached_count` (Number) Number of resources the group is attached to.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `is_default` (Boolean) True for the project `default` group.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules of the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `SYNCING` or `ERROR`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `direction` (String) `ingress` or `egress`.
- `id` (String) Rule ID (use with `h3_security_group_rule` import).
- `port_from` (Number) First port.
- `port_to` (Number) Last port.
- `priority` (Number) Priority.
- `protocol` (String) `all`, `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp`.
- `remote_cidr` (String) Peer CIDR.
- `remote_security_group_id` (String) Peer security group.
